title: Google Maps ka Confidence
text:
Google Maps: "In 200 metres, take a right."
Main: right le liya.
Google Maps: "Rerouting…"
Bhai, tumne hi toh bola tha! 🗺️

title: Free WiFi
text:
Cafe wala: Sir, WiFi free hai.
Main: Password?
Cafe wala: Ek coffee order kijiye.
Main: Matlab WiFi free hai, aap nahi. ☕📶

title: Auto Wala aur Meter
text:
Main: Bhaiya, meter se chaloge?
Auto wala: Meter kharab hai.
Main: Toh theek kyun nahi karate?
Auto wala: Theek ho gaya toh main kharab ho jaunga. 🛺

title: Online Shopping
text:
Website: Size chart dekh kar order karein.
Main: Size chart dekh kar order kiya.
Parcel: Ek gudiya ke liye perfect fit. 📦

title: Group Photo
text:
Group photo ka rule:
29 log perfect aate hain,
aur ek banda har baar aankh band kar leta hai.
Aur wo banda hamesha main hi hota hoon. 📸

title: Fan ki Speed
text:
Duniya me do hi tarah ke log hote hain:
Jo fan ko speed 3 pe chalate hain,
aur jo seedha 5 pe daal ke chaadar odh lete hain. 🌀

title: OTP aur Memory
text:
6 digit ka OTP 10 second yaad rehta hai.
6 marks ka answer 10 saal nahi.
Dimaag ki priority samajh nahi aati. 🔐

title: Barber ka Sheesha
text:
Barber: Sir, peeche se dekh lijiye.
Main: Haan, badhiya hai.
Sach ye hai ki mujhe kuch dikha hi nahi,
par mana bhi kaise karta? ✂️

title: Lift ka Button
text:
Lift ka button ek baar dabane se kaam karta hai.
Phir bhi hum use 7 baar dabate hain,
jaise lift ko motivation ki zarurat ho. 🛗

title: Restaurant ka Menu
text:
10 minute tak poora menu padha.
Waiter aaya.
Maine kaha: "Wahi, jo hamesha lete hain." 🍽️

title: Charger ka Rishta
text:
Duniya ka sabse mazboot rishta:
Mera charger aur uska 3 inch ka wire,
jo har baar exactly bed tak nahi pahunchta. 🔌

title: T&C Wala Jhooth
text:
Duniya ka sabse bada jhooth:
"I have read and agree to the Terms & Conditions."
140 crore log, ek hi jhooth. 📜

title: Shaadi ka Khana
text:
Shaadi me plate leke ghoomna ek art hai.
Ek haath me plate, doosre me pani,
tisre haath me gulab jamun —
aur teesra haath kahan se aaya, wahi toh kamaal hai. 🍛

title: Printer ka Mood
text:
Printer duniya ki ekmatra machine hai
jo kaam se zyada excuses deti hai.
Paper hai toh ink nahi,
ink hai toh mood nahi. 🖨️

title: Autocorrect
text:
Maine likha: "Main ghar pahunch gaya."
Autocorrect ne bheja: "Main ghar pahunch gaya hoon shayad."
Ab mummy poori raat chinta me hai. 📲

title: Subah ki Neend
text:
Duniya ki sabse aramdayak neend?
Alarm band karne ke baad wali 9 minute ki neend.
Usme jo sukoon hai, wo 8 ghante me nahi. 😴
